about: The host describes the drive as a way to give children in foster care a holiday many of them have not known. Heart of Missouri CASA calls it the biggest mission yet for the event, with the aim of stuffing as many Jeeps as possible with new toys.
The listing is categorized as a fundraiser. Logboat Brewing Company, the venue, lists a phone number of 573-397-6786 on the host page for questions.
Because the evening centers on a brewery taproom setting with Santa photos and lights, families with young children may want to plan around the 5 PM start.
faq: What should I bring to Stuff the Jeep?
The host asks guests to bring a new, unwrapped toy to Logboat Brewing.
Yes, the host lists photos with Santa among the festive activities.
The toys benefit Heart of Missouri CASA, according to the host.

about: Columbia Mall lists the sessions in H&M Court on four evenings: Monday December 7, Tuesday December 8, Monday December 14 and Tuesday December 15, each from 4 to 7 PM.
